pools.closed: No lap swim is posted for the next two weeks.
notes: Indoor 50 m pool, laned as 25 yd most of the day; long-course lanes on some mornings.
Day pass for non-members at the front desk; it covers lap swim, not family or recreational swim. Membership also available.
Each block shows how many lanes are open for lap swim. Changed hours on Oct 30 (Asphalt Screams) are only on the Asphalt Green page.

pools.name: Riverbank State Park Aquatics Center
notes: Indoor 50 m pool (October to Labor Day), run by New York State Parks.
Adult lap swim needs a Lap Swim Card; entry $2 (16+), seniors $1. Entry stops 30 minutes before the session ends. Bring a padlock.
Holiday hours aren't in the schedule; check the park's page.
